name: Amber Golem

source.note: An amber guardian for the Amber Temple on the 2024 Stone Golem's numbers (SRD 5.2.1), under its own name. Legendary actions and a lair of the temple's own (owner, 2026-10-27, the boss plan's last part).

languages: understands its creator's languages but can't speak

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.summary: Effects that would change its shape don't work on it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two attacks, Slam or Force Bolt in any mix.

actions.name: Slam
actions.summary: A crushing amber fist humming with force.

actions.name: Force Bolt
actions.summary: A bolt of force up to 120 ft.

summary: A towering construct of polished amber: two crushing fists and a pulse of magic that slows everyone near.

bonus_actions.name: Slow
bonus_actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. Casts Slow (Con, DC 17) as a Bonus Action.

options.name: Grinding Stride
options.summary: Moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

lair_actions.name: The Amber Hardens
lair_actions.summary: Amber wells up round one foe's legs and sets: DC 15 Str save or Restrained until the end of the golem's next turn.
lair_actions.text: Liquid amber wells up out of the floor round one creature the golem can see within 120 feet and hardens. It makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw or has the Restrained condition until the end of the golem's next turn.

lair_actions.name: Amber Shards
lair_actions.summary: Shards burst from the amber walls at two foes: DC 15 Dex save, 2d10 Piercing, half on a success.
lair_actions.text: The amber in the walls cracks and sprays shards at up to two creatures the golem can see within 120 feet. Each makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) Piercing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
